settings.heading: Come and Try — or just ask
settings.subheading: The best way to find the right ebike or trike is to ride one. Book a free test ride at our Gaythorne workshop any weekday, join us at an upcoming event, or send us a question — whatever suits you best.

settings.title: Try the full range
settings.body: Commuter, cargo, folding, and adaptive trikes — all set up and ready to ride.

settings.title: One-on-one fitting
settings.body: Our team will match you to a bike, adjust the fit, and walk through controls.

settings.title: No pressure, no cost
settings.body: Free to attend. No sales pitch — just bikes, riders, and good coffee.

settings.title: Quiet test street
settings.body: Prospect Rd is low-traffic — perfect for first-time and nervous riders.

settings.title: Full range on-site
settings.body: Commuter, cargo, folding ebikes and Trident trikes all ready to ride.

settings.title: Expert fittings
settings.body: Our mechanics will adjust the bike to you before you head out.

settings.title: Accessible entry
settings.body: Step-free access and undercover ride zone for wet days.

settings.heading: Test ride at our Gaythorne workshop
settings.body: Can't make an event? Drop in to our Gaythorne workshop any weekday. We've got the full range ready to ride, a quiet street out front for first-timers, and an undercover space for wet days.
settings.parking: Free street parking on Prospect Rd, plus accessible bays at the front of the unit.
settings.transit: 5 min walk from Gaythorne train station (Ferny Grove line). Bus 390 stops on Samford Rd.
settings.driving: 8 km / 15 min north of Brisbane CBD via Kelvin Grove Rd and Samford Rd.

settings.heading: Get in touch or book a ride
settings.subheading: Tell us what you'd like to try and when suits — we'll have a bike ready, at an event or at our Gaythorne workshop.

settings.question: Do I need to book?
settings.answer: Events can be drop-in or RSVP — check the event details. For a Gaythorne workshop visit, RSVP so we can have the right bike ready.

settings.question: What should I bring?
settings.answer: Flat shoes, a water bottle, and your ID for test rides. Helmets are provided. If you'd like to test with your own gear (e.g. orthotic, support cushion), feel free to bring it.

settings.question: Is it suitable for first-time or nervous riders?
settings.answer: Absolutely. Our team specialises in supporting riders of every ability. Trikes are very stable and a great place to start, and Prospect Rd outside our workshop is quiet enough for true beginners.

settings.question: Can I bring a support worker or OT?
settings.answer: Yes — we love working with OTs, physios, and support workers. Let us know in your enquiry and we'll allocate extra time.

settings.question: What if it rains?
settings.answer: Our Gaythorne workshop has an undercover ride zone. For events we'll email you the day before with weather updates.

settings.location_body: Most Brisbane events run from our workshop. Plenty of street parking, accessible entry, and an undercover ride zone for wet days.
